title: Scroll the product catalogue with touch gestures on a phone
steps: Swipe upward across the visible product rows.

video_guide.summary: The orange circle and trail visualize the same recorded touch gesture. After the upward swipe, All products remains open without navigating into a product.

chapters.note: All products and the Travel Shoe Bag row are visible in the phone-sized viewport.

chapters.label: Swipe upward across a product row

chapters.note: An orange touch circle and upward trail overlay a product row; these are recording annotations.
All products remains visible after the gesture, with the original touch trace retained briefly.
The touch annotation has cleared; the catalogue and its product rows remain visible.
